chart.title: Share of countries that have had a woman as chief executive
chart.subtitle: Share of current countries that have had a woman as chief executive since 1789.
chart.note: "Chief executive" is defined here as the head of government (such as Germany's Angela Merkel) or the head of state (such as Argentina's Cristina Fernández de Kirchner), whoever has more power over the appointment and dismissal of cabinet ministers. Democracies as identified by V-Dem's "Regimes of the World" classification.

Share of countries that had a woman chie.descriptionShort: Share of today's countries that had ever had a woman chief executive by the end of the given year. A woman counts for a given year if she held the office at any point during that year.
Share of countries that had a woman chie.descriptionProcessing: We estimate the share based on the countries that V-Dem lists in the most recent year of the data.

Share of countries that had a woman chie.descriptionShort: Share of today's countries that had ever had a woman chief executive who took office through multi-party elections while the country was an electoral or a liberal democracy, by the end of the given year. A woman counts for a given year if she held the office at any point during that year.
